Tame/Bonded/Devoted: follow any Friendly food-holding player from Idle. Head tracks player; Curious animation plays while following.
If beyond soft leash radius for a set period, return home.
Tame: head tracks the owner when within 8 blocks (slot set by CreatureTierSlotSystem). Continue so wandering/idle behaviors still run.
Bonded: head tracks the owner when within 10 blocks. Continue so the step-toward-owner branch below still evaluates.

Bonded: only while the owner is STANDING STILL (BondedOwnerStill slot, ~1.5s without moving) and within 10 blocks, occasionally walk a few slow steps toward them (not a jump; Seek at 0.3 speed, stops at 3 blocks); otherwise linger and watch. NOTE: this branch ends the Idle pass, so while the owner stands still nearby a Bonded Sprout will not wander, graze or nap; it resumes normal idle once the owner moves.
Devoted follow: actively seek the assigned owner. Registered by CreatureLeashTrackingSystem via role.setMarkedTarget.

Sensors.$Comment: Timid, speed-scaled: a RUNNING, NON-CROUCHING, non-friendly player triggers flee at the full AlertedActionRange. A crouch-walking player can still read as 'running', so crouching is excluded with a separate sensor (one MovementState filter per filter list, so Running/Sprinting/Crouching are each their own Target sensor).
Timid, speed-scaled: a SPRINTING, NON-CROUCHING, non-friendly player triggers flee at the full AlertedActionRange.
Timid, speed-scaled: a slower (walking/standing), non-crouching, non-friendly player only triggers flee at 75% of AlertedActionRange.
